en_US: Mr. Backlot is the master of this
mansion. This is his office.
This is the way out to the trophy
garden.
The garden is open for all visitors
to enjoy.
However, please beware--wild Pokémon
may appear in the garden.
Welcome.
Here, you may challenge the mansion’s
pride--the five Trainer maids.
The challenge is to beat all five of us
in a row without a break.
After us, our very own prodigy,
Lady Celeste, will battle you.
The first time you triumph over her,
there will be a special gift.
And now...
The 5-Maid Knockout Challenge!
Would you like to try?
Oh, how disappointing...
Please take the challenge sometime.
Very well!
Our first maid, please!
Congratulations!
You have defeated four maids so far.
One maid remains, and then
Lady Celeste.
How splendid of you!
You swept the five maids!
And now, the last of the challenge:
our very own prodigy, Lady Celeste!
Your splendor is authentic!
Sweeping the floor with the five maids
wasn’t enough for you, oh no!
Why, to think you would triumph over
even our Lady Celeste!
The challenge is complete! You have
triumphed over us and Lady Celeste.
I’m so sorry. Everything beyond this
point is strictly off-limits.
Please, you really mustn’t.
Mr. Backlot will be so cross with me!
First up! I do the mansion’s laundry!
I will open the proceedings!
The next person up is quite strong,
really.
I’m pleased to meet you in battle.
I tend the mansion’s gardens!
I was no. 2, and a little bit tough!
The next maid is even tougher!
I dust every room, top to bottom!
Not a speck escapes me!
The next maid is a wee bit stronger
than I am.
I cook for the whole mansion!
I’m the fourth in line!

messages.en_US: Th-the next maid up is really strong!

en_US: I’m the head maid! I hold the keys!
Prepare for no. 5!
You knocked out the five of us!
You have to be splendid!
Oh, my... You must show me how good
you are for the ladies to call me out.
Oh, my! My, my, my!
Your technique was most enchanting.
For a first triumph, the house has a
gift for you. Please, take this.
I will take my leave now.
Giggle...
Lady Celeste asked me to keep this
for you until you had room.
The expensive-looking book Mr. Backlot
has... It tugs at my attention.
Darach: Hold, please!
I am Darach, valet to Lady Caitlin.
My lady is a guest of Mr. Backlot.
No one goes farther into the mansion
without first defeating us.
We battle together, two Pokémon at
a time. Will you accept our challenge?
Caitlin: Then show me a battle worth
staying awake for.
Darach: Splendid. Lady Caitlin and I
yield. The mansion is open to you.
A maid found this Egg on the beach.
Mr. Backlot asked us to give it to
a Trainer of true strength.

messages.en_US: Darach: Please care for it well.

en_US: Darach: Your party is full. Come back
with room, and the Egg is yours.

messages.en_US: Darach: I have kept the Egg for you.

en_US: Darach: Our battle needs at least two
Pokémon able to fight. Do return.
Darach: Very well. We shall wait here
for you.
Darach: Lady Caitlin enjoyed your
battle. Please, do visit again.
Caitlin: Darach decides who may pass.
I only watch... and battle.
Caitlin: That battle was refreshing.
I may even stay awake a while.
